The '''1967–68 Cypriot First Division''' was the 29th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 12 teams, and [[AEL Limassol]] won the championship. [[Olympiakos Nicosia]] participated in the [[1967–68 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]] as the previous year's champions. They finished in the 17th position.
